note: Set B is better because it extracts specific member profiles (W8X10, W10X12, HSS, PL sizes) and keynotes, whereas Set A uses vague terms like 'structural element' and 'duct framing' for most claims. Set A also contains a critical unit error (reading 6" as 6' ft). Both sets struggle with binding dimensions to the correct detail view (often attributing Roof Framing A3 dimensions to Duct Framing details), but Set B's specificity and correct unit reading make it more useful despite having more duplicate claims.
remarks: Both sets frequently misattribute dimensions from the Roof Framing Detail (A3) to Duct Framing details, likely due to proximity in the text layer or visual complexity. Set B's claim of '1/4" V' for a weld in C1 appears to invent the 'V' as the text layer only shows '1/4"'.
